plainName: Deductions are taken from gross total income
summary: The deductions of this part of the Act are allowed from your gross total income, which is your income under every head before any of them. Together they can never be more than that gross total income, however many you qualify for; whatever would go beyond it is simply not allowed. In the default regime only the few deductions it keeps are allowed at all.

routes.name: All the deductions together, within gross total income
routes.description: Each deduction is worked out under its own rule; the total of them is then held within your gross total income.
